pages.text: The $(d)XP Attraction Field$() Gene causes players to $(9)grab XP Orbs from a much larger distance$().$(br2)This Gene is disabled when the player has an active $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/anti_field_orb)Anti-Field Orb/$, is near an active $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/anti_field_block)Anti-Field Block/$, or when sneaking.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
